answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond into a time-locked vault that only unlocks after peers attest its work across several epochs. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds, so faking scale costs real capital. Slashing the bond when graders catch copied answers, as easily as telling dyed glass from real onyx or a yarrow sprig from weeds, turns each detection into a direct loss for the attacker.
